verdict.rationale: Attio explicitly offers an MCP server and API for AI tools (Claude/ChatGPT) to search, update, and manage workspace data, and markets AI features including 'create account briefs' and interaction history visibility, supporting the core capability. However, evidence is largely marketing copy without concrete proof of a full agent workflow pulling open deals + emails + history end-to-end via API/MCP, so it delivers with meaningful caveats.
